title: Lithium Americas Corp. Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At March 31, 2026, cash and restricted cash totaled USD 1.21 billion. Thacker Pass targeted late-2027 mechanical completion; USD 1.1 billion of the USD 2.93 billion technical-report capex estimate had been spent, and fiscal-2026 project capex guidance was USD 1.3-1.6 billion.
summary: The unchanged SEC filing remains the current retained evidence for construction, capex, liquidity, ownership, DOE and GM funding, warrants, dilution, schedule, and pre-revenue risk; it does not explain the July price decline or support a common-equity valuation.
